description: nhflow_3d_amr_adaptive_kw (adaptive patches, k-omega on every grid) with subcycling (G 7 1): every step of a level starts with the turbulence step of its patches with the time step of the level, the cells around them from the level or the parent (turb_level); after the two steps of a level its fields are restricted into the covered cells of the parent (turb_sync).
covers: A 560 with G 7 1 no longer refused
